title: Uruguayan Roasted Casserole
description: A hearty, flavorful casserole that combines the richness of roasted vegetables with the warm spices of Uruguay. This dish is perfect for a chilly evening.

ingredients.name: mixed vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as carrots, potatoes, and onions

instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil.
Open the casserole mix and follow the instructions to prepare it.
In a separate pan, heat the roasted red peppers over medium heat.
Add the mixed vegetables to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the prepared casserole mix to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Sprinkle the spice mix over the top of the casserole.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is heated through and the top is lightly browned.
